$comment: Dialect registry. Data, not switch branches — adding a harness dialect is a JSON edit. Each entry maps a client family to the layout it expects, the skill format, the agent format, and where the files go.

claude-code.label: Claude Code
claude-code.notes: Skill directories hold SKILL.md with name + description frontmatter.

codex.label: Codex
codex.notes: Expects a YAML envelope with interface and policy keys.

agentsmd.label: AGENTS.md
agentsmd.notes: Single append-only markdown file. Sections are delimited by <!-- skills-library:name:X --> markers so a single skill can be replaced without rewriting the file.

cursor-rules.label: Cursor rules
cursor-rules.notes: Plain prose rules; no frontmatter required.

generic-mcp.label: Generic MCP client
generic-mcp.notes: No install convention. The client calls render_skill and stores the result wherever it likes.

markdown.description: Body only, no frontmatter. The most portable form.

claude-frontmatter.description: YAML frontmatter with name, description, and optional allowed-tools.

openai-yaml.description: YAML document with interface, policy, metadata, and instructions keys.

agentsmd.description: Markdown section with skills-library name markers.

cursor-rules.description: Prose rule file with a heading and a trigger line.
